name: video-sdk-service
description: Raw WebRTC video calling microservice with pluggable auth
author: Saad Srabon

scripts.dev:lan:https: npm run cert && cross-env HOST=0.0.0.0 USE_HTTPS=true tsx watch src/index.ts
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:sdk
scripts.typecheck:all: npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck --prefix packages/client-sdk
scripts.demo: npm run build:sdk && npx --yes serve . -l tcp://0.0.0.0:5000
scripts.demo:https: npm run build:sdk && npm run cert && npx --yes serve . -l tcp://0.0.0.0:5000 --ssl-cert certs/dev-cert.pem --ssl-key certs/dev-key.pem
